factorAttribution.insight: Quality had the highest average IC (+0.031, spread +1.2%/period). Value averaged negative IC (-0.014) — adaptive weights should not increase that pillar when IC stays negative. Suggested blend vs effective ranking mix: Quality 12% → 12%.
